paragraphs: Direct Music Rights Buyer

SPACE buys revenue-generating music catalogs directly. Ambient, lo-fi, meditation, electronic and house are examples, not a required genre list. Every catalog is reviewed individually. No auction. No listing.
Free initial review · No obligation to sell · Partial sales considered · Individual assessment across genres
Business days after relevant information, if a fit
Auction or listing commission
Defined rights, subject to agreement
Fit
Rights and income reviewed individually
Direct answers

SPACE is a direct music-rights buyer for independent catalog owners. It buys revenue-generating catalogs in ambient, lo-fi, meditation, electronic, house, wellness, and soundscape genres without using an auction marketplace.

We review contactability, transferable rights and documented income individually. Start with a free review request; we confirm the evidence needed by email. No automatic minimum or guaranteed offer is implied.

SPACE considers documented income, trends, platform mix, rights, contracts and track concentration. A calculator scenario is not an offer. The acquired share, payment conditions and actual price require individual review and agreement.
The decision
Same catalog. Completely different outcome.
Read the complete selling guide →
Process
Start with your email and artist or label name. We follow up by email to request the relevant streaming links, royalty statements and rights documents privately.
We review documented income and the rights offered. If the catalog is a fit, an initial offer typically follows within 5-7 business days after the relevant information is received.
Review the agreement with an independent adviser. Payment follows the completed agreement and satisfied rights-transfer conditions. Confirm what stays yours, including future work.
What we buy
From mood catalogs to commercial electronic rights, we evaluate catalogs with real demand across streaming, creator channels, wellness apps, and licensing.
New expansion includes Deep House, Melodic House, Progressive House, Tech House, Techno, Melodic Techno, Trance, Drum & Bass.
Atmospheric textures, drones, soundscapes

Deep, melodic, progressive, and tech-house rights
Melodic dance catalogs for travel and lifestyle media
Instrumental music for deep work
Field recordings, environmental audio
Yoga, spa, sleep, therapeutic audio
If you need the number first
Monthly net income x 12 x your assumed multiple x the share sold = your scenario. Choose your own assumptions. This is not a market valuation, payment date or SPACE offer.
